parameters.jsonBody:
=
{{ JSON.stringify({
  statement: `
    MATCH (target:Concept)
    WHERE toLower(target.id) = toLower($conceptId)
       OR toLower(target.name) = toLower($conceptId)

    OPTIONAL MATCH
      (before:Concept)-[:LEARN_BEFORE]->(target)

    WITH target,
         collect(DISTINCT before.name) AS prerequisites

    OPTIONAL MATCH
      (target)-[:LEARN_BEFORE]->(after:Concept)

    RETURN
      target.id AS conceptId,
      target.name AS concept,
      prerequisites,
      collect(DISTINCT after.name) AS nextTopics,
      'project-curated-learning-path' AS source
  `,
  parameters: {
    conceptId: $json.conceptId
  }
}) }}
